scenes.content: The 500 Internal Server Error is a generic error message returned when the server encounters an unexpected condition that prevents it from fulfilling a request.
Common Root Causes:;1. Syntax errors in server-side scripts;2. Permissions issues on files or folders;3. Database connection timeouts;4. Resource exhaustion (RAM/CPU)
How to Fix:;1. Check the server error logs immediately;2. Verify file permissions (e.g., 755 or 644);3. Check .htaccess configuration;4. Increase PHP or Node.js memory limits
Remember: A 500 error is not a client problem. It is a signal that the backend code or environment needs attention.
